newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end lower; await Friday's data.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end lower; await Friday's data.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended with modest losses Thursday as Wall Street awaited Friday's wholesale price index for September and retail sales.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average was off 8.95 points at 5,921.67. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 12-10 on subdued volume of 393 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
